text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of other users' counter-argument comments, not the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself asserts or cites specific numerical data or statistics as part of its argument (concrete figures, percentages, rates, counts, dates-as-quantities, numeric study results; need not be verified or externally sourced), else 0. Incidental numbers not used as data (list numbering, "two reasons") and purely general/qualitative claims don't count; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is retainable but counts only if it is itself numerical data used in argument. Ignore moderator/bot notices, and exclude OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous or resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.
